examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I'm listening right by my ear.
The car is parked near the house.

examples.text: Возле дома Аникеева ходили два подозрительных человека.
examples.trans: Near Anikeev's house two suspicious people were walking.

examples.text: Хватит ворчать, Миша, у меня завтра утром свадьба!
examples.trans: Stop grumbling, Misha, I'm getting married tomorrow morning!

examples.text: Папа, не ворчи, да ты сначала попробуй!
examples.trans: Dad, don't grumble, just try it first!

examples.text: Решается ваш вопрос, Клавдия Викторовна! Вы не видите, у меня встреча?
examples.trans: Your question is being sorted out, Klavdia Viktorovna! Can't you see I have a meeting?

втроём.gloss: the three of us, three together

meanings.en: the three of us, three together

examples.text: Да, теперь мы живём здесь втроём.
examples.trans: Yes, now the three of us live here.

examples.text: Пойдём втроём: ты, я и Настя.
examples.trans: Let's go, the three of us: you, me and Nastya.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

выпить.gloss: to drink (up); to have a drink

meanings.en: to drink up, to have a drink of

examples.trans: May I drink a tiny drop of beer?

examples.text: Милый, можно я выпью капельку пива?
examples.trans: Darling, may I drink a tiny drop of beer?

related.gloss: to go on a drinking binge

выходить.gloss: to go out, to get out

meanings.en: to go out, to come out

examples.trans: I'm going out in a minute.

examples.text: Ты мне даёшь пятьсот рублей, а я выхожу и покупаю тебе лучшую приставку в мире.
examples.trans: You give me five hundred roubles, and I get out and buy you the best console in the world.

examples.text: Клавдия Викторовна, к вам гости! Па-пам!
examples.trans: Klavdia Viktorovna, you have visitors! Ta-da!

meanings.note: + dative of person + accusative of thing
imperative давай/давайте + 1st person plural or infinitive

examples.text: Давай мы его уволим, а тебя на его место назначим.
examples.trans: Let's fire him and put you in his place.

related.gloss: to hand in; to take (an exam)
to reach, walk as far as

examples.trans: Call me this evening. We'll arrange something for tomorrow.

examples.text: Да я обязательно буду на вас жаловаться!
examples.trans: I will definitely complain about you!

examples.text: Нам с тобой вообще грех жаловаться.
examples.trans: You and I really can't complain.
The guests are complaining that it's very cold.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

examples.text: Ты его так расхваливаешь, будто женить собрался.

examples.text: Позвони мне вечером. Договоримся на завтра.
examples.trans: Call me this evening. We'll arrange something for tomorrow.

meanings.en: civil registry office (for marriages and births)

examples.trans: The town registry office is right nearby.

examples.text: Теперь мы вместе пойдём в ЗАГС.
examples.trans: Now we will go to the registry office together.

meanings.en: into marriage (of a woman marrying a man)

examples.trans: He asked me to marry him and come to Moscow!

examples.text: Она вышла замуж в прошлом году.

examples.trans: He courted me after a concert once. He asked me to marry him and come to Moscow!

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.
There's someone here to see you.

examples.text: Аркадий Борисович, извините, тут к вам человек.

meanings.note: Как вы знаете = as you know.

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: В любой момент = at any moment.

examples.trans: First we quickly divorce you two, and then we marry us!

examples.trans: We were dancing. First they were rude and insulting over there.

examples.trans: Don't be afraid, everything is fine! We will sit together in a friendly way at the table.

There's someone here to see you.

examples.text: Аркадий Борисович, извините, тут к вам человек.
examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich, I'm sorry, there's a man here to see you.

related.gloss: to get a job, settle in

examples.trans: Right, can you cut out all this noise? We only need Anikeev.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
